complete_physical_bvh.inclusion_rule: All and only saved-reopen MESH objects with physical_bvh_include=true, using evaluated world meshes.
limits: Allowed overlap is a geometric contact envelope only; thread, seat, clamp, torque, and bearing identity remain UNVERIFIED.
Invalid source BRep remains invalid even if its tessellated evaluated mesh participates in BVH.

fail_closed: Mesh cleanliness records are observations, not repairs or watertight certifications.
First-hit PASS is limited to modeled world-mesh proxies; official semantic optical faces remain UNVERIFIED.
Any BVH illegal collision remains explicitly BLOCKED; allowed adjacency is not a fit proof.
Private Blend and render evidence cannot be independently reverified from the public package.

first_hit_world_mesh.limit: Proxy world meshes prove deterministic path interception only; they do not establish official CAD optical faces or coatings.

limits: No finite beam radius, coating phase, polarization transform, OPL, dispersion, or detector response is established.
CCR internal chord and 633-to-810 phase mapping remain UNVERIFIED.
